operations.content: The research landscape reveals a critical gap: field consensus on KG fine-tuning shows everyone flattens graph structure into text (id:23364a94), yet prior art in graph-traversal reasoning (PoG, GCR, ReMindRAG, FastKGE) demonstrates that structure-aware approaches outperform flattening at top venues (id:516ec716). The market and research gaps are identical: applied graph traversal reasoning to personal knowledge architecture.
